entries.text: At the Center of This World
On the Night of the Festival
So That I Can Be Me
Into the Endless Cycle of Battle

A special order brings together a new unit of New
Earth Federation elites. Pride sets its recruits at
odds, but under Colonel Neo Roanoke they repel a
joint AEUG-ZAFT force. Having recognized each
other's skill, they receive Special Order 013:
capture or destroy the unknown BG, Black Gale.
Special Task Force 013 is born, and a new battle
begins.

Task Force 013 knows almost nothing about BG,
except that it is dangerous enough to require their
combined elite skills. They find it, but a Shadow
Angel attack ruins the capture. After barely
repelling the Shadow Angels, they face the Hundred
Demon Empire. Civilian allies, the Siberian Railway
Guard, save them. With new comrades and doubts
about their motley ranks, they head to McConnell
Base for more reinforcements.

Phantom Pain meets new comrades; Anemone and
Cynthia see themselves in its members. Near
McConnell Base, Beck and Corin nearly come to
blows, then unite against alien attackers. Task
Force 013 joins them and repels the aliens, but a
block word leaves Auel mentally unstable after the
battle. Back at base, Beck and Corin join the unit.
Chimera's Dr. Jie arrives with fresh supplies.

Ordered to guard a weapons test, Task Force 013
expects trouble after its recent experiences. The
new weapon, Orange, triggers a space-time tremor,
releasing bizarre, vividly colored creatures. The
unit repels them without understanding what is
happening, then receives orders to keep the
operation secret. Angry at being dragged through
aimless missions, they vow to finish the BG hunt
and disband. News arrives that BG has been located.

Dr. Jie has plans for Task Force 013. They find BG
and fight for their own reasons. Defeated, BG still
escapes. As they pursue it, a vast, unidentified
mobile weapon appears. They fight without knowing
its pilot, barely win, and learn nothing. News then
arrives that BG has been captured. Their mission
complete, Task Force 013 disbands. Its members
return to their own battles, carrying memories of
their time together.

As space-time restoration nears, the group recalls
past battles at UN Station. Kira smiles at Renton
and Eureka's bond. Hap and Matthieu recall
Gekkostate's rookie initiation: Renton gave his all
to a dangerous mission, unaware it was a prank.
Gainer exposed it, and Ken-Goh lectured the
culprits. Yet Renton's sincerity forged a bond with
Moondoggie, and his earnest feelings became the
strength to save Eureka.

As space-time restoration nears, the group recalls
past battles at UN Station. Roger and Banjo tell of
meeting Renton's grandfather Axel in Bellforest.
Dominic was also there, investigating the Thurston
family. As Banjo questioned him about Dewey
Novak's plans, Schwarzwald appeared. Roger and
Banjo fought him, but Big O malfunctioned. Axel's
mechanical skill saved them. Thinking of his waiting
grandfather, Renton vows to return with Eureka one
day.

As space-time restoration nears, the group recalls
past battles at UN Station. Asked about his
travels, Roger tells of a town plagued by bandits.
Instead of his peaceful negotiation, its people
chose to fight, inspired by Noir 7, mercenaries who
left armies and organizations for their beliefs.
Moved by them, Roger fought as a meddlesome
individual, not a Negotiator. Reminded of all who
live in the Multi-Dimensional World, the group
resolves to restore space-time for everyone.

On the way from Tampagunda Base to Gibraltar,
Sandman invites the group to his villa. They relax
in hot springs shaped by his distinctive tastes. A
table-tennis tournament brings unexpected
heart-to-heart encounters. Refreshed, they easily
repel attacking Zeravire. Eiji and Lunamaria win the
tournament, only to face Sandman's terrifying
table-tennis skills. Back at Saint-Germain Castle,
Sandman tells Raven he is ready to face his past.

Teral recalls life as Lila with the real Teral, Lila's
late lover. Disgusted by Butcher's frivolous battles,
Teral orders an Eldar-only attack. Toshiya's group
is astonished and exasperated that Martino sells
God Sigma's blueprints. The Eldar use them to
exploit its weakness. Rie's desperate rescue of
Toshiya reminds Teral of that former life, causing
Teral to hesitate to attack. Gattler scorns the
retreat as a woman's way of fighting. Furious,
Teral renews the resolve to fulfill the mission.

Seeking Black History's power, Guin sends
prospector Sid to Gallia and asks Joseph to
investigate nearby Mountain Cycles. The site is the
forbidden Lost Mountain, hiding nuclear weapons.
Loran's group fights Breakers who unearthed them.
Cornered, the Breakers try to use the weapons, but
a mysterious Overman emerges and neutralizes them.
The group repels its attack without understanding
events. Enthralled by Black History, Guin sends Sid
to Wulgusk to investigate further.

Star 3 trains to master the Virgola Glory. Athrun
wonders at her strange strength but joins the
others in helping her train. Near Gibraltar Base,
the New Earth Federation attacks. One enemy is a
man Denzel once refused entry to Glory Star. When
he insults the team's honor, Star 3 fights him in
anger, armed with what Denzel and Toby passed
down to her.

As news of the New Earth Federation coup shakes
the world, the group stays at Tresor Institute in
South Ameria to refit Nirvash. While the women
diet, the Hundred Demon Empire rots the food
supplies, leaving everyone starving. Dr. Gura
attacks the weakened group. Fasting sharpens
Aquarion's senses: its Food-Seeking Explosive
Arrow strikes the invisible Mecha Fortress Demon.
Victorious, they enjoy Fudou's feast, but Silvia and
the others gain even more weight than before their
diet.

Ana and Adette go alone to a nearby town. Ana
wants to contact her father Medaiyu about Wulgusk
without worrying the others. Moved, Adette promises
to help. Asuham's former aide Zakki attacks, and
Adette risks her life to keep that promise. With
Gainer's help they repel him and contact Wulgusk,
but Medaiyu rejects Ana out of parental concern.
Understanding his love, Ana thanks her father and
cries her heart out in Adette's arms.

Someone asks for Roger by name to negotiate for
flowers from a garden. He and Mel visit, but its
owner refuses to sell them. Roger then negotiates
with a crooked property firm that wants the
garden. Talks fail, as he expected; finding him a
nuisance, the president sends assassins. With
Dorothy and the group's help, Roger defeats them
and obtains the flowers. They bring Roger and
Dorothy closer, while his client Dominic gives them
to Anemone to soothe her heart.

The group worries over Pierre's strange behavior.
Tex and Mischa diagnose combination addiction.
Meanwhile, Renton and Garrod take Eureka shopping
on the girls' advice, as she worries about her
facial scars. Shadow Angels attack. Pierre risks his
life to protect his first love Esperanza and his
family, moving Apollo, Renton and the others.
Fudou's advice helps him grow and win. Eureka and
the girls also take a step toward adulthood, and
the group renews its resolve to fight for this
world.

Space-time restoration has stabilized the
Multi-Dimensional World, but a hidden threat
awakens. Turn A and King Gainer go berserk for
unknown reasons as unmanned forces attack
worldwide. Facing an enemy of unknown origin and
purpose, nations led by the New Earth Federation
and PLANT form an independent force across
national and organizational lines. Carrying people's
hopes for the future, the group begins a new
battle in North Ameria and Gallia.

Gathering in North Ameria, the group reviews the
attacks. All they know is that the unmanned forces
are Black History relics awakened from Mountain
Cycles. Their autonomous control mechanism earns
the machines the name Executor System. More
machines attack. The group repels them, sensing a
deliberate purpose unlike the attacks elsewhere.
Banjo and Roger arrive with news that the enemy's
base is in Japan. The group heads to the trade
point to meet its comrades from Gallia.

Gathering in Gallia, the group reviews the attacks.
All they know is that the unmanned forces are
Black History relics awakened from Mountain Cycles.
Their autonomous control mechanism earns the
machines the name Executor System. More machines
attack. The group repels them, sensing a deliberate
purpose unlike the attacks elsewhere. Banjo and
Roger arrive with news that the enemy's base is in
Japan. The group heads to the trade point to meet
its comrades from North Ameria.

Banjo and Roger describe Black History's end as
depicted in the book Metropolis: destruction,
rebirth, and an Executor. Suspecting a system built
to remove humanity and restore Earth's environment,
the group goes to Japan to uncover the truth and
stop the machines. A mysterious black Overman
awaits. Gainer realizes it controls the Executor
System. Ghingnham appears in Turn X. Defeating him,
the group pursues the black Overman into the
Japanese Alps.

The black Overman controlling the Executor System
is King Gainer's counterpart from a parallel world.
The group answers its question about humanity's
meaning. Believing in human potential and valuing
life, they fight to stop the system. Defeated, the
Overman thanks them and vanishes. Its purpose
remains unknown, yet they sense its care for
humanity and Earth. They vow to its spirit to keep
fighting for a better future.

At the Lunar Lutetium base, the combat research
team Glory Star was conducting evaluation tests on
the Earth Federation's next mass-produced unit, the
Virgola. Star 3, newly assigned, felt doubts about
her mission due to Titans' slander, but was
encouraged by chief Denzel and others. An AEUG MS
unit attacked the base to seize the Virgola. Forced
to sortie, Glory Star was caught in a space
distortion during battle.

When Glory Star came to, they were in an unknown
colony, Armory One. For self-defense, they fought
the defense force. Meanwhile, intruders stole a new
mobile suit. With Shinn in Impulse and Alex, Orb's
representative's bodyguard, they chased the
intruders, who escaped the colony. Minerva's captain
Talia ordered the ship to launch and told Shinn to
take in the surrendered Glory Star.

The Minerva pursued intruder Bogey One, but
struggled against Commander Neo's trap. Alex's quick
thinking saved them, but then, from a spatial
distortion, AEUG and Titans forces appeared. Amid
the confused battle, Glory Star sided with AEUG,
normally its enemy, and the unknown ZAFT. The
battle ended in AEUG/ZAFT's victory, but a new
distortion swallowed Glory Star. Durandal sought
contact with AEUG to grasp the situation.

Transported to another world, Grendizer and the
Vega Fleet faced off. Glory Star joined the
decisive battle. They cornered King Vega, but an
unknown alien weapon appeared, letting him escape.
After repelling the aliens, the Earth Alliance
surrounded them as Unknowns. To avoid trouble,
they obeyed the military.

The group is harshly questioned at an Alliance base
as suspected citizens of the hostile PLANTs. They
tell all to Blue Fixer's seemingly sympathetic
Tsukikage and Quinstein. The aliens return to
Suruga Bay. At Heizaemon's orders, Kappei fights in
Zambo Ace, said to be his ancestors' legacy. Duke
Fleed's group helps repel the aliens to defend the
town. The Alliance again tries to detain them, so,
at Heizaemon's orders, they flee to Beal I, the
battleship they excavated.

Amid reports of Unknowns, a party hosted by the
mysterious magnate Sandman was held in Tokyo. He
announced Earth was targeted by new invaders,
Zeravire. As he said, Tokyo came under attack.
Kappei and the others intercepted. In battle,
Sandman's Earthgertz trump card, Gravion, appeared.
Sandman displayed Gravion's power and declared to
the Earth Alliance that Duke Fleed and the group
were under his protection.

Kappei left Saint-Germain to meet his father
Gengoro on his return from deep-sea fishing. Back
home, misunderstanding and prejudice led Kazuki and
others to demand the Jin family be cast out. Aliens
attacked again, but Kappei refused to fight for the
selfish townsfolk. Toshiya in the newly completed
Kuuraiou and Kappei's cousins Uchuta and Keiko
fought instead. Encouraged by Gengoro and the
others, Kappei resolved to fight, completing Zambot
3's combination. Victorious, they headed to space
to stop Junius Seven's fall.

The Minerva and Argama rushed to stop Junius
Seven. Amid poor coordination, the culprits were
revealed as Coordinator dissidents. To sway public
opinion, Phantom Pain let it fall, aided by the
Titans, and aliens further plunged the battlefield
into chaos. King Beal joined, and the fragmentation
began. But a distortion swallowed Glory Star. A
huge shard of Junius Seven was about to crash to
Earth.

Glory Star was transported to an orbital elevator
in South America. Amid the confusion, Kei and Orson
fought a force attempting to seize the elevator,
and Glory Star joined them. Although they defeated
the first wave, more reinforcements appeared. Kei
activated a spacetime quake bomb to destroy the
orbital elevator. In the ensuing chaos, a mysterious
figure shot down Denzel. The bomb then brought the
world to an end.

The wandering repair shop Beater Service meets
Garrod, flung from Ameria, at a bazaar. Breakers
raid for his Gundam; The Heat and Garrod repel
them. Exodus contractor Gain saves them mid-fight,
then hires them as partners.

With Gain, the group takes on the Exodus of the
Domepolis Wulgusk. Gainer, an ordinary boy who
loves video games, is arrested by Sibe Rail on
suspicion of Exodus ties. Gain infiltrates the city
and ends up rescuing him. They seize the lord's
Overman and take his daughter Ana hostage.
Repelling Sibe Rail, they begin an unprecedented
Exodus with entire city units moving together.

Gainer resented being pulled into Exodus and took
it out on Sara, the girl he admired. Gain and the
others fought Siberian Railway as it pursued
Yapan's ceiling. Siberian Railway hired Zora's
Breakers, the Hola family, as mercenaries, and used
them as decoys while Yassaba closed in. Gainer
staked his pride, challenging Yassaba and unleashing
King Gainer's Overskill. The Heat's connections
brought Iron Gear as backup, and they repelled
Siberian Railway. Afterward, Gainer joined Exodus to
repay Gain.

Seeking revenge on those who humiliated him,
Yassaba infiltrated Yapan's ceiling. Adette was also
there to rescue Ana, but Gain caught her. Yassaba
burst in, throwing the ceiling into chaos. Seizing
the moment, Kejinan tried to take over Siberian
Railway, recruiting Hola and attacking. In the
confusion, Yassaba escaped with the fortune-teller
girl Eifa, vowing to stop Exodus. The battle ended
in his defeat, and bereft of all, he set out on an
Exodus with Eifa.

Beater Service searches for Cielo Beater, lost to a
warp. A new warp brings Gekkostate and the United
Federation chasing them. The Heat offers a
ceasefire, but meddling forces a fight anyway.
Another warp then swallows Gekkostate and Iron
Gear alike.

Thrown from Gallia to North Ameria by a distortion,
the group took refuge with local boy Loran. Loran,
of the Moonrace, had lived undercover on Earth for
two years to test their planned return. As the
Moonrace return began, a misunderstanding led the
Dianna Counter to attack. Loran fought back in the
White Doll, a mobile suit revealed inside a statue
at the coming-of-age ceremony. Iron Gear's crew
assisted, repelling the Dianna Counter. Lord Guin,
negotiating with the Moonrace, prepared his next
move.

As a bargaining chip in negotiations, Guin hired
Iron Gear's crew as bodyguards. From Enil's
contact, Garrod learned Tifa was captured by the
Frost brothers and held in this city. During the
Moonrace welcome party, Garrod rescued Tifa. Loran
saved him from the Frosts. Amid the chaos, Dianna
Counter joined, aiming to weaken Earth forces. The
battle ended when Loran confessed his Moonrace
identity and Dianna appeared in his support.

In a lark, Dianna and Kihel swapped places. The
group heading to a joint exercise with the Moonrace
was shocked by the sight. Investigating, Jiron and
the others met Apollo and his friends. Mysterious
girls were seeking Apollo. Then the enemy Shadow
Angels appeared. As Aquarion, the trump card,
struggled, Apollo, enraged at his friend Baron's
abduction, was guided into it. They won thanks to
Apollo, but Toma was already planning his next
move.

Sirius and the others learn their town was warped
to another world. The Shadow Angels attack again;
Iron Gear meets them with Aquarion. Apollo beats
Cherubim troops sent by Toma, who presses him to
recall a past life. Their contact stirs a rift, and
far off, a quake bomb ends the world.

The bomb that ended one world also marked the
beginning of a new one. Learning that the stranded
Kei was a Singularity, Emaan's Factory offered him
protection. Chiram also sought the Singularity and
tried to capture him. Resisting their forceful
approach, Kei fought alongside Glomar to repel
them. A mysterious mobile weapon then appeared,
and Kei drove it off with the New Federation's
Phantom Pain. He was astonished when Shaya and
the others told him that a new world had been
born.

A series of strange murders in the memory-wiped
Paradigm City. Dorothy and the others searched for
the missing Roger, encountering incidents wherever
they went. Finally, the culprit R.D. appeared, and
escaped Beck's gang caused chaos, until Roger
summoned Big O. After Roger repelled Beck,
Schwarzwald attacked him in a mysterious Megadeus,
then left cryptic words and departed. Roger decided
to leave Paradigm City in search of truth.

Bored with his ordinary life in Bellforest, Renton
met the mysterious girl Eureka. As the New
Federation and Gekkostate clashed over her, Renton
summoned his courage for her. With Titans, ZAFT,
and AEUG, the battle became a melee, and Renton
unleashed Nirvash's Seven Swell via the Amita Drive
from his grandfather Axel. As Axel pressed
Gekkostate to leave, Renton chose to journey with
Eureka.

At Trinity City in the Pacific, anti-alien forces
gathered around King Beal. Blue Fixer recovered a
mysterious spacecraft. Then the Eldars, who wiped
out Jupiter's Io colony, appeared. Burning with
rage, Toshiya, with Julie and Kiraken, completed God
Sigma's combination. With new power, King Beal
departed to fight aliens worldwide. Meanwhile, the
Eldars allied with Gaizock and Vega to destroy
humanity.

The Dianna Counter targeted Fort Severn, an
autonomous city in North Ameria, as their return
point from the Moon. But this was the military's
reckless act, not Dianna's will. Carris hired Freeden
to counter them. Iron Gear's crew and the Frosts'
New Federation forces appeared, and in the melee,
Dianna, disguised as Kihel, tried to swap with Kihel
disguised as Dianna. The swap failed, but Fort
Severn was defended. The defeat only accelerated
the military's recklessness.

At a trading point halfway between Gallia and
Ameria, Chiram attacks Kei. The New Federation,
ZAFT, AEUG, aliens, King Beal, Shadow Angels,
Freeden and Iron Gear also arrive, plunging the
battlefield into chaos. After narrowly repelling the
enemy, the group is contacted by Capt. Lowen of
Chimera, the New Earth Federation's special unit.
Those who have fought separately around the world
are now gathered together.

Argama and Minerva, chasing Gekkostate, are forced
to fight them. Renton's cry halts it. Their will to
fight gone, all join to meet the New Federation
troops that appear. A mystery suit repels an alien
- Kira's Freedom, which once ended the last war.
After, Talia meets Gekkostate's leader Holland,
abandons the attempt to secure their cooperation,
and instead commissions them for a job.

Duke Fleed visited Trinity City. Seeking his role in
the alien war, he met the S-1 alien Marin, an enemy
alien shunned by the crew. When alien attack forces
appeared, Toshiya and Duke Fleed fought but
struggled against the subspace tactics of S-1's
Aldebaron army. Quinstein asked Marin to sortie.
Marin and the others, awakened by Duke Fleed's
words, defeated Aldebaron with Baldios.

Independent Orb denied Talia's request for aid. Its
representative Cagalli was a figurehead; the Seiran
family held power, secretly allied with the New
Federation in the name of protecting Orb. Leaving,
they were caught between the New Federation and
Orb forces. Struggling against the enemy's new
weapon, they were saved by Karaba's Amuro and
Shinn's unprecedented performance. After the
battle, Shinn was consumed by anger at Orb, but
kind words soothed him. The Freeden crew split off
to watch Orb's moves.

In Orb, which had announced its alliance with the
New Earth Federation, Yuna and Cagalli's wedding
was about to take place. Coordinator assassins
closed in on Lacus and Kira, who lived peacefully
there. Kira drove them off in Freedom, realizing
they had no place in the New Federation, PLANT, or
Orb, and fled with the Archangel crew, taking
Cagalli on an aimless journey. The Minerva, now
joined by Athrun, crossed to Gallia to join Yapan's
ceiling.

The group opens a market to earn a living. The
Dianna Counter shows up to plunder supplies.
Defending themselves, they repel Chiram too. Kei
notices a familiar- moving Chiram machine. Dianna,
as Kihel, aches at the Counter's wayward path.
Chiram's plan to capture Kei, the Singularity,
advances, led by his friend, Orson.

Awaiting them at Yapan's ceiling was their former
foe Adette. During a relay-race event held to ease
friction within the unit and the residents'
frustration, Asuham appeared, seeking Gain as his
sworn enemy. Gain beat him in a duel, but Asuham
summoned Saint Regan and Siberian Railway to
attack in numbers. Roger, appearing as Exodus'
negotiator, saved the day. The group pressed on
toward the legendary Yapan, continuing their
Exodus.

A refugee caravan was allowed aboard Yapan's
ceiling. Kappei spotted Kazuki and his group, who
blamed the Jin family for their exile and vented
their rage on him. Ignoring a mysterious man's
advice, Kappei flew into a rage and attacked the
aliens in Zambo Ace alone. As the Shadow Angels
joined the chaos, he learned the value of comrades
and defeated the enemy together. His example
reminded Dianna of her own duty, and she revealed
her true identity to Loran.

Dome Polis Katez, the refugees' destination, is
about to be seized by the Dianna Counter. At the
lord's request, Roger goes with Guin to negotiate,
but talks break down. Asuham's scheming drags the
group into a fight with the Dianna Counter, until
Kihel, posing as Dianna, ends it with a word, and
Dianna entrusts the Dianna Counter to her. Having
beaten Asuham, the man behind it, the group bids
the refugees farewell and rejoins the Minerva and
Argama.

Gainer and the others tried to capture a Skyfish
at Holland's request. They struggled against
Planetta, piloted by Siberian Railway operations
director Kashmir, and Gain's Gachiko was badly
damaged. However, Gainer's love confession to Sara
shook Kashmir, and the party won. Though Sara was
angered by it, Gainer earned Renton's respect. In
the chaos, the party formed an independent
guerrilla unit to work together across factions.

Glory Star knowingly accepted Asakim's provocation.
After repelling Chiram, Asakim's Shrowga attacked
them. They cornered Asakim with the party, but it
was his trap all along. Toby was shot down, and
Asakim left, carving an undying fear into them.
Star 3, grieving another lost comrade, decided to
live as a warrior, encouraged by those around her
and by Lowen.

Answering a call for help from their benefactor
Asakim, Beater Service rushes over. They join
Asakim in repelling Chiram, but The Heat is wounded.
Through the pain he also beats a mysterious woman
chasing Asakim. After, Asakim leaves without saying
much.

Kashmir and Timp made a final gamble to stop
Yapan's ceiling. A mysterious Overman said to serve
the Siberian Railway president Kizz Munt appeared,
and the battle raged. There, Kashmir's scheme
revealed that Gauli killed Gainer's parents. Gain
forced Gainer to fight. The party repelled the
Shadow Angels with Getter Robo, and the Exodus
succeeded. But Gainer, unable to settle his heart,
decided to begin his own Exodus with his friends.

Roger negotiates the sale of the Saotome Institute,
but Director Saotome refuses. Roger's mysterious
client curses and dismisses him. An unknown enemy
attacks; with the Getter Team away, the Elements
fight to defend the institute, but chaos erupts as
the Hyakki Empire, Shadow Angels and Schwarzwald
arrive. Roger's help and the Getter Team's return
win the day, yet the Hyakki Empire in society's
shadow shakes the group. Then Boss brings word
that the Photon Power Lab has fallen.

Using the seized lab, the Hyakki Empire drives
Koji's group back. Hidler gloats; Tekkouki seeks a
showdown with his sworn enemy Getter Robo. Koji's
group storms the lab, prepared to risk their lives,
and with Tetsuya retakes it. Mazinger Z and Great
Mazinger crush the Empire. They vow to wipe out
the Hyakki Empire hiding in Japan.

To catch the Hyakki Empire in one net, the group
knowingly accepts the enemy's invitation. Moroha of
the Shadow Angels strikes, and Aquarion, lacking
teamwork, is cornered. Moved by Tekkouki's resolve
to abandon even his homeland for pride, the group
breaks both the Empire and the Shadow Angels.
Beaten by Sandman and Fudou's plan, the Hyakki oni
all take their own lives. Japan will rejoin the New
Earth Federation under Chimera, while Holland and
Jamil tell Talia they will act apart.

The ZAFT-led group stopped in Hong Kong for
supplies from Karaba. Enjoying their free time,
Shinn and Kamille met girls named Stella and Four.
In battle with Phantom Pain, the psycho Gundam's
pilot was Four. As Kamille held back, Touga
unhesitatingly tried to finish off the disabled Four.
Eiji stopped him, but was angered by Touga's cold
reasoning.

With Harry of the Dianna Counter, the party
attacked the New Federation's Lohengrin Gate. Local
cooperation and Shinn's efforts won, but Shinn, lost
in rage, tried to fight beyond necessity. Against
the new Zeravire, the uncoordinated Gran Knights
couldn't combine. They barely won, but Eiji,
distrusting Touga, left the ship. Teteth, plotting
to assassinate Dianna, was beginning to realize
that she was disguised as Kihel.

The party found Eiji, but his resolve was firm and
he would not listen to their attempts to persuade
him. As the alien alliance attacked, Toshiya and
others sortied, but Gaizock's objective was to
abduct the townsfolk. Teral, moved by Toshiya's
courage, responded in kind. Against a new Zeravire,
the reunited Gran Knights fought but were
outmatched. Sandman granted them a new power, the
Super Heavy Sword. He rejoiced in the victory of
the now more mature Gran Knights, yet his past
wounds ached.

The party fought Phantom Pain. With Orb, allied to
the New Federation, joining, the Archangel and
Freedom appeared and called for a truce. When their
call was rejected, Freedom attacked the party to
stop the fighting. In the chaos with the Ghingnham
fleet, Heine fell. A mysterious woman serving
Asakim also attacked. After the battle, the party
was baffled and angered by the Archangel and
Freedom's inscrutable actions.

The party investigated a ruined lab. Human
augmentation had been studied there, and its horror
shook Rey. Phantom Pain moved to recapture or
destroy the lab, the New Federation's dark secret.
In the fight, Shinn protected Stella and Kamille
persuaded Four. But Four sacrificed herself to
preserve her comrade Auel's memory. The Freedom
then shot down the pursuing Athrun. With a bitter
victory, the party realized the threat of leaving
the Archangel and Freedom unchecked.

Bright and the others met with Brigadier General
Edel at the Tampagunda base. Meanwhile, the party
learned of their detachment's selfish actions and
grew angry. To overcome her fear of Asakim, Star
3 answered his call. Fighting Ziene, Asakim's ally,
she was saved by Capt. Lowen and her friends'
voices. Regaining her fighting spirit, she defeated
Ziene. After returning, she met Edel and asked Dr.
Jie of Chimera to refit the Virgola for the battles
ahead.

Star 3 sortied in the refitted Virgola at Toby's
call. But waiting was Land, Asakim's ally, and they
fought. In battle, Toby appeared and shot Star 3.
This Toby was Asakim, who had used supernatural
powers to take his form. Her grief peaked,
transforming Ganary Carver into something utterly
alien. Asakim, defeated by that power, rejoiced in
her awakening. Afterward, though troubled by the
words of Land, who had been deceived by Asakim,
she resolved to fight on with the new Virgola.

Heading to Gibraltar, the party tried to rendezvous
with the Radish, carrying supplies from space. Alert
to Phantom Pain, Kamille and others went ahead, but
the enemy had already attacked. Kamille treated the
inexperienced Fa coldly despite her determined
fighting. But it was Fa who saved him from Jerid's
new machine. With the Zeta Gundam, Kamille drove
off Jerid and the others. Afterward, Kamille found
peace in Fa's presence. Neo was removed from
command of Phantom Pain, and Commander Scirocco
went to the front to take direct command.

At Gibraltar, Dianna and Durandal met, but talks
failed. Quattro then met Durandal and learned of
the multi-world crisis. That night, at Lacus Clyne's
concert, Dianna was abducted. Kamille, pursuing,
faced Paptimus Scirocco. In Phantom Pain's base
attack, Reccoa was shot down, and a coup broke
out in the Dianna Counter. Revealing herself, Dianna
boarded Soleil to save Kihel, switching places again.

Shinn and Rey's punishment for letting Stella go
was surprisingly light. Kamille chided the arrogant
Shinn. On their own judgment, the party pursued
the Soleil to save Dianna. Amid attacks by
Ghingnham's fleet and the New Federation, the
Freedom appeared and offered help. But despite
their efforts, Dianna was taken to space. Harry
and Kihel accepted the Archangel's offer and went
to space with them. As the party reeled, news
came of the New Federation's invasion of Chiram.

King Beal took in the amnesiac refugees. Kappei
found Hamamoto, Kazuki's comrade, among them. The
party intercepted the Gaizock attack. Mid-battle,
the refugees' section exploded. The Gaizock had
turned them into human bombs. Kappei burned with
rage, but the enemy was too strong. Earth's
science couldn't defuse the bombs. Hamamoto and
the others left, living in fear of detonation.
Kappei and his friends had no words to give them.

Duke Fleed heard troubling rumors on UN as he
moved to join the party. The party, burning with
hatred for the aliens, judged they couldn't win and
decided to contact the Dianna Counter to gather
intel on the Moon. The Eldar army attacked. God
Sigma's new weapons won, and they captured Teral.
But Toshiya let him go to stop the human bombs.
Against the party's emotional call for total
resistance, Duke Fleed left in silence.

Invited to Sandman's villa, the group hears the
truth of the Zeravire, his own secret, and his ties
to Leele. Kappei is shaken, but a mysterious man,
Banjo, encourages him back to himself. Phantom Pain
attacks under Faye, and an enemy strike stirs
Leele's memories. New Federation spy Mizuki then
completes her mission and leaves the Gran Knights.
Touga, meaning well, tells Leele the whole truth,
and the shock leads to her suffering serious
physical injuries. As the Gran Knights come apart,
word arrives of the New Federation invading Chiram.

The New Federation suddenly invades Chiram, and its
powerful new weapon destroys the capital. The
group fights back, but the Archangel and their
former comrades arrive; they berate the group and
fight the New Federation alone, causing chaos.
Kamille and Shinn struggle in vain: Four and Stella
lose their lives, and Shinn burns with hatred for
the Freedom that caused Stella's death. Condemning
the attack, Durandal exposes the Council of Sages
and vows to bring it down.

Durandal's speech threw the world into chaos, and
angry citizens demanded the complete removal of
the Council of Sages and its faction. Seizing this
chance, a coup broke out in the New Earth
Federation under Scirocco and Dewey. The reformed
government pinned all blame on the Council to
project a clean image, but the group grew uneasy
about the enemy lurking behind it. They defeated a
New Federation unit they encountered, but there
stood the Archangel and their former comrades.

The group faced the Archangel and their former
comrades. Talia, tasked with shooting down the
Archangel, advised surrender, but with no common
ground, battle began. Shinn targeted the Freedom
and fought with all his might, finally shooting it
down. This prompted the Archangel and Iron Gear
forces to retreat. Then Banjo appeared and
revealed the truth: the group and their friends
had been used by someone.

Dewey publicly declares the Coralians to be
humanity's enemy and promises to exterminate them,
winning overwhelming public support. The group
encounters Coralians by chance and, without knowing
what they are, joins the New Federation forces in
trying to repel them. Although the Coralians seem
to keep appearing endlessly, they reach their
activity limit and die out. Meanwhile, Durandal
meets a mysterious figure calling himself the Black
Charisma.

Warned by Mizuki of the New Earth Federation's
spacetime control experiment, the group sets out to
seize it. Many factions arrive, drawn by the Black
Charisma, and their former comrades appear too. In
the confusion Bloodman fires the spacetime quake
bomb to break the deadlock. What should have
caused only a minute shift triggers destruction on
the scale of Break the World. Amid it, the Black
Charisma throws ominous words at the group.

Having refused ZAFT's help, the group considers
what to do next. Meanwhile the Gekkostate is in
uproar over a Coralian. Overwhelmed by the vast
cloud-like being, the group takes Holland's request
and tries to bring Eureka and Renton into contact.
A black KLF like the Nirvash appears with the New
Federation. Slipping through their attack, the
Nirvash makes contact, and the group meets
something like an illusion. A transfer throws them,
and when they come to, Tiffa has been taken.

Renton got word of Tiffa's whereabouts from
Dominic, a New Federation officer he met in town.
The Zonder Epta held an eerie legend. Garrod and
Renton went ahead alone for recon, but were caught
with the Freeden by Katock's scheme. With Holland's
desperate charge, Jamil's resolve to save Lucille,
and Katock's help, Garrod launched the DX. They
rescued Tiffa and Eureka, but Holland made Renton
realize his own helplessness. Jamil and Holland saw
themselves in Katock and mourned him.

Getter and Aquarion lost due to poor teamwork. The
Elements worked on Fudou's harsh training, but were
baffled by it. Meanwhile, Gyukenki challenged
Getter. Despite his doubts, Ryou faced him. In the
ensuing battle against the Shadow Angels, Getter
and Aquarion won with new power. Fudou left
cryptic words behind. Shaya and Mimsy then set
course for Emaan.

Entering Emaan, the group is captured, all but Kei.
Shaya's sister Manisha will not rule out mind
control if Kei, the key to repairing spacetime,
refuses. Emaan pursues them after a mysterious
woman, Ziene, helps them escape, and Glomar
resolves to leave Emaan. As ZAFT and Chiram
arrive, Slay sacrifices himself to protect Mimsy.
Knowing now they are outsiders with nowhere to
belong, the group draws closer.

To hide from various pursuers, the group fled to
an LFO excavation site in South Ameria. As Holland
grew frustrated, Eureka complained of illness to
Renton, but he had no room to care. When enemies
appeared, Eureka went alone into the cave. Renton
followed and saw her merging with the Scub. In
response to his shock and regret, the Nirvash
activated the Seven Swell, letting the group escape.

At Sarta base, the group met with Chimera and
grew angry at their former comrades' atrocities.
They retrieved a senior Vodarac monk from Chiram
at Chimera's request, where Renton again saw
Holland's resolve and his own naivety. Mel's father
Cielo appeared, but it was a trap set by Asakim to
harm Beater Service physically and mentally. With
Lowen and Setsuko's help they repelled the enemy,
but Mel, learning of her father's disappearance and
her body's secret, rejected The Heat.

Holland and the others met Brigadier General Edel
and were impressed by her noble character.
Meanwhile, The Heat, with Dr. Jie's help, unsealed
Ganleon. The Heat pursued Asakim on Setsuko's
intel, but could do nothing without Ganleon. While
their allies provided support, Beater Service
regained their bond, unleashed Ganleon's sleeping
power, and defeated Asakim. As the group
celebrated victory and spent time with Brigadier
General Edel, Renton left the ship out of
self-loathing.

Fed up with Holland's selfish behavior, Garrod and
the others search for Renton. After meeting
various people in town, Renton gets to know the
mercenary couple, the Beams. Circumstances bring
the group together with Pala, a girl from space, to
fight the thugs rampaging through town. Ennil also
accepts her own feelings and helps them. After the
battle, Renton leaves Garrod and the others with
the Beams. Respecting Renton's decision, they
choose to wait for his return.

While waiting for Renton to return, the group
enjoyed their freedom. Roger gave Kei a message
from a mysterious person. His old friend Orson, now
a Chiram soldier, was asking for his cooperation.
But Robert, eager for glory, tried to capture Kei
by force. Orson helped them escape, but vengeful
Asuham and his men appeared. They repelled them,
but Glomar reported the main force's dire straits,
forcing their return. Orson, having disobeyed
orders, was summoned home, and pondered who was
right, himself or Kei.

Gekkostate separated from the main force to settle
things with their old acquaintance Charles.
Meanwhile, Renton was offered adoption by the
Beams, but chose Eureka and left them. Charles and
Holland clashed. Eureka and Renton reunited, and
the others who defeated the Overdevil joined up.
Despite Renton's cries, the Beams vanished into the
flames. As word of the New Federation's invasion of
Chiram reached them, Asuham revived the true
Overdevil.

At the Lunar Skull Moon base, spy suspicions arose.
Aphrodia ordered Flick, the suspect, to hunt Marin.
Meanwhile, Marin was finally opening up. Flick swore
to fight with his old friend and left Aldebaron, but
Aphrodia had anticipated this in her plan. With the
group trapped in a sealed space, Flick turned
against them out of self-preservation. Knowing his
true heart, Marin struck him down for his friends.
Following Flick's last words, Marin deliberately let
Aphrodia, who had failed to escape, go. Moved, Duke
Fleed vowed to help the group.

Gainer finally met Cynthia, his game rival, and they
became friends. Siberian Railway' president Kizz
Munt decided to make an example of Gain, who had
undertaken Wulgusk's Exodus, and personally crush
him and his allies. Kizz cornered the group with
Agat's crystal and a massive army. Gainer and Sara
dodged the approaching Cynthia and charged the
crystal, but the Overdevil revived. Its overwhelming
power forced the group to retreat. Defeated by
Cynthia, Gainer vowed to retrain himself to bring
her to her senses.

The group helped Gainer train to surpass himself.
The decisive battle against Siberian Railway with
the Overdevil began. The Shadow Angels also
appeared to defeat it. As Rena's vision showed, the
two had been ancient foes. Gainer succeeded in
destroying the Overdevil, but Cynthia left. The
group reunited with Gekkostate, but news of the
New Federation's invasion of Chiram arrived.
Meanwhile, Asuham revived the true Overdevil.

The New Federation invades Chiram, its new weapon
destroying the capital. The group fights alongside
the Archangel to stop it, but their former
comrades appear, berate them, and fight the New
Federation alone. They down the giant mobile suit
at the enemy's core, only for its pilot to be
someone Shinn knew. Their former comrades leave,
angry at the group's selfishness. Durandal reveals
the Council of Sages and declares he will bring it
down.

Durandal's speech throws the world into chaos, and
angry citizens demand the expulsion of the Council
of Sages. Seizing this, a coup breaks out in the
New Earth Federation under Scirocco and Dewey. The
reformed government pins all blame on the Council
to project a clean image, but the group grows
uneasy about the enemy behind it. They defeat a
New Federation unit, but those who appear there
are their former comrades.

The group faced their former comrades. Talia,
tasked with shooting down the Archangel, advised
surrender, but with no common ground, they fought.
Shinn's fierce focus on the Freedom overwhelmed
Kira, and the Freedom was finally shot down; the
Archangel also took damage from the Minerva.
Guided by Banjo's appearance, the group withdrew
and learned from Orson that they and their friends
had been used. Talho then revealed that Eureka was
a Coralian.

The group headed to Tresor Institute to upgrade
the Nirvash. Dewey announced the Coralians as
humanity's enemy and declared their annihilation.
Learning Dewey was awakening antibody Coralians,
they moved to stop him. In that battle, the reborn
Nirvash flew with Renton and Eureka. But they were
forced to fight the antibody Coralians that
appeared and reluctantly destroyed them. Meanwhile,
Durandal met with the mysterious figure calling
himself the Black Charisma.

Learning from Athena of the New Earth Federation's
experiment with a spacetime control device, the
group planned to destroy the device. But guided by
the Black Charisma, various forces, including former
comrades, appeared. Amid the chaos, Bloodman
decided to activate the time-space vibration bomb
to break the deadlock. What should have been a
tiny warp instead caused Break the World-class
spacetime destruction. Then the Black Charisma cast
ominous words at the group.

Reunited, the group realized that someone had
manipulated them into misunderstanding each other.
The Emaan fleet attacked to seize the singularity.
Shaya declared her will to her sister Manisha and
protected them from Chiram's forces. After
repelling the enemy, Chiram's leader invited them to
talks including Emaan. Shaya attended as
representative and vowed to act beyond national
and racial borders, and Manisha trusted her.
Chiram's leader told Shaya the group itself had
become the singularity.

Taking advantage of the Second Break, Gagarn
arrives from the Eldar homeworld and dismisses
Teral. In response, Teral stakes his pride on a
decisive battle with Earth. Facing him, Kappei learns
that Aki has been turned into a human bomb and
burns with rage. The sight devastates Teral and
makes all the fighting seem futile to him. During
the battle, the Zeravire's fierce assault also
claims Eina and Luna as casualties. Shocked, Touga
leaves the ship.

ZAFT questioned Minerva's crew for defending the
New Federation HQ. At Gibraltar, Shinn and Rey
received new power from Durandal. Ordered to hunt
deserter Athrun, they reluctantly shot him down. In
space, Harry and Eternal fought to rescue Dianna
before her handover to the New Federation.
Ghingnham's Turn X intervened. Kira joined in Strike
Freedom to fight ZAFT. Dianna entrusted the future
to Kihel and joined Ghingnham on the Moon to
reveal the Black History.

Aldebaron executed the Earth flood plan to seize
control of Skull Moon. Through encounters with
Rubina and Teral, Aphrodia began to waver. The
group attacked the artificial sun with all forces
but struggled against the enemy horde and Shadow
Angels. Revived Gran Knights and Sol Gravion saved
them. With David's support, they stopped the plan
and captured both Futaba, a Shadow Angel child, and
Aphrodia. As the group rejoiced, Quinstein wore a
complex expression.

Learning S-1 is Earth's future shocks the group.
Quinstein theorizes that spacetime destruction at
the Black History's end spawned countless parallel
worlds, including Zora and S-1. To learn the truth,
they move to rescue Innocent leader Arthur and
Vodarac leader Norb from the LOGOS stronghold
Heaven's Base. There Holland confronts his foe and
older brother Dewey, declaring war. Arthur tells
them of a lunar facility that records the Black
History, where a Newtype's will sleeps.

ZAFT demanded the surrender of Orb, where the
LOGOS remnants had taken refuge. But Orb prepared
to fight to the end without evacuating its
citizens. The group focused on capturing Djibril to
minimize damage. He escaped to space, and
Ghingnham and the Space Revolutionary Army threw
the battlefield into chaos. With Kira and Athrun
joining, they broke through, but ZAFT accused them
of obstructing its operations. Cagalli, who had
returned to Orb, and the real Lacus exposed
Durandal's plot to the world, deepening the chaos.

The group notices changes in Star 3's body as she
pursues Asakim. Led by Asakim, she is forced to
fight Denzel and Toby from a parallel world. As she
is overcome with grief, Lowen shoots her from
behind. Schlan and Ziene appear too. Before the
group, who rush to her aid, Chimera declares its
true aim: to rule the world and wipe them out.
The group repels Chimera but is shaken by Lowen's
true identity. With her life slipping away, Star 3
vows to devote what remains of it to the fight.

Out in town, The Heat meets Asakim and they talk
at a bar, enjoying a strange friendship that
transcends their roles as hunter and hunted. During
a fight between rogue soldiers and the Gunleon,
Lowen shoots The Heat from behind, and Schlan and
Ziene appear. Before the group, who rush to his
aid, Chimera declares its true aim: to rule the
world and wipe them out. Driving Chimera off, the
group is shaken by Lowen's identity. Despite feeling
a strange bond with Asakim, The Heat resolves to
face him with everything he has.

To find clues to talking with Coralians, the group
heads to Vodara Shrine, the Vodarac headquarters.
The Hyakki Empire waits with soldiers enhanced
using human body-modification techniques. After the
group defeats Hidler, Glen, implanted with Shadow
Angel wings, attacks in his assault Aquarion.
Despairing at humanity's dark side, Sirius awakens
as a Shadow Angel through Toma's guidance. Inside
the palace, Sakuya and Norb entrust their hopes to
Eureka and Renton. In the chaos, Alan abducts
Dorothy in Big Duo.

Chasing the Hyakki Empire's fortress, which has
obtained dimensional power, the group is caught in
a spacetime warp. Roger wakes in Paradigm City,
where Alex's emissary Alan closes in. With
Dorothy's power, Roger and the group defeat Alan,
and Alex tells them of the existence of a great
power. The Hyakki Empire appears, seeking
dimensional power, which is one aspect of that
greater force, but the group defeats it. Then the
Overdevil appears and absorbs Gainer.

LOGOS's Requiem devastates PLANT. Gainer, absorbed
by the Overdevil, has captured Gauli and Sara too.
As the group risks death to fight it, Shadow
Angels Sirius and Moroha, Chimera, and Glen appear.
Reika's cry restores Glen's humanity; he
sacrifices himself to kill Moroha. Inspired, Tsugumi
breaks Sara and Gauli's enthrallment. Sara and his
friends' voices restore Gainer, who saves Cynthia
and destroys the Overdevil. Silvia breaks with
Sirius and vows to fight.

In space, the group attacked Requiem's relay
station with Archangel's help. After battle, Talia
revealed Durandal's order to defeat them and
announced her return to ZAFT. Shinn and Lunamaria
refused, choosing to act on their own will. Rey,
rejecting this, declared he would defeat Shinn and
left with Minerva. Accepting Archangel after Talia's
parting words, the group was joined by Haman, who
also rejected Durandal's ways.

As the group attempts to enter D.O.M.E., Requiem
stops: D.O.M.E. has accepted Tifa's will. Dianna
reveals the sealed Black History: spacetime
destruction created a time loop, and their present
war will become that history. The Frost brothers
attack the shocked group, seeking revenge on the
world and Durandal, whose Destiny Plan twisted
their fate. In battle, the Turn A and Turn X
awaken their Moonlight Butterflies. Dr. Kazami
abandons Earth to join the aliens.

The group fights the forces of Kazami, who has
defected to the Eldar, and King Vega, who is
prepared to fight to the death. Kazami stoops to
taking Toshiya's father and the others hostage, but
Teral's help gets the group clear. Joined at last
by Sandman's God Sigma Gravion, they destroy the
Skull Moon base. There, Hugi declares the start of
the alien alliance's final operation, and Dianna calls
on all mankind to stand together against the
aliens.

After parting from Minerva, the group heads into
space to launch a surprise attack on the aliens'
lunar base. But Dr. Kazami's betrayal has warned
the enemy in advance, and the operation fails. A
ZAFT unit that regards the group as an enemy
arrives as well. The Archangel saves them from the
crisis and joins forces with them. They clear up
their misunderstandings and reconcile. Meanwhile,
LOGOS fires its trump card, Requiem, at PLANT.

To stop Requiem from striking PLANT, the group
attacked relay stations. Before them, the Space
Revolutionary Army's colony laser destroyed a
station. Haman, ruler of Axis, tried to recruit the
group, but Quattro refused. They fought Axis and
the Space Revolutionary Army on the colony laser,
with the New Federation joining. Garrod's quick
thinking destroyed the laser, but Quattro saw
danger in Haman's hidden intentions.

As the group attempts to enter D.O.M.E., Requiem
stops: D.O.M.E. has accepted Tifa's will. Dianna
reveals the sealed Black History: spacetime
destruction created a time loop, and their present
war will become that history. The Frost brothers
attack the shocked group, seeking revenge on the
world and Durandal, whose Destiny Plan twisted
their fate. In battle, the Turn A and Turn X
awaken their Moonlight Butterflies. Despairing at
humanity's dark side, Sirius awakens as a Shadow
Angel.

Seeking clues to talking with Coralians, the group
heads to Vodara Shrine, the Vodarac headquarters.
The New Federation and Glen's assault Aquarion
attack. The Hyakki Empire arrives with soldiers
enhanced using human body-modification techniques,
as do the Shadow Angels. As mysterious Megadeuses
appear, Sakuya and Norb entrust their hopes to
Eureka and Renton inside the palace. Amid the
chaos, Megadeus commander Alan abducts Dorothy,
and the arriving Overdevil absorbs Gainer.

The group pursues Gainer, who has been absorbed
by the Overdevil, but Gauli and Sara are captured
too. Risking their lives against the Overdevil, which
seeks to freeze the world from its center in Liman
Megalopolis, they free Sara and Gauli from its
control. Hearing the voices of Sara, Gain, and his
friends, Gainer regains himself, rescues Cynthia, and
destroys the Overdevil. As the group celebrates
victory, Angel appears with the abducted Dorothy.

The group fights Kazami and King Vega as they
attack Chateau Saint-Germain, and struggles against
Kazami's science. Kazami takes Toshiya's father and
the others hostage and joins hands with the
arriving Hyakki Empire. With Teral's help and
Sandman's God Sigma Gravion rising at last, the
group escapes the crisis and defeats Kazami's
forces. There, Hugi declares the start of the alien
alliance's final operation, and Dianna calls on all
mankind to stand together against the aliens.

In Orb, the Dianna Counter regretted their actions
and prepared to rush to Dianna's side. Humanity
faced the alien coalition centered on Zeravire's
mobile fortress Goma, but the New Federation and
Aprilius Alliance held each other in check, neither
willing to act. The group alone engaged the
coalition, defeating Butcher, Gagarn, Gattler, and
Hugi and destroying the alien alliance. But after
settling his score with Hugi inside Goma, Sandman
wished to perish with Zeravire. Then Goma began to
reveal its true form.

The group fought desperately to stop Goma but
struggled against Shadow Angels and the Frost
brothers. Meer saved them by risking her life to
sing her own song. Moved, New Federation and ZAFT
reinforcements arrived one after another, reversing
the tide. With Sandman regaining his will to live,
the group defeated Goma. At the same time, Kappei,
facing Gaizock's god, Computer Doll 8, had his past
battles denied. But he remembered his reason to
fight and defeated Gaizock with his friends.

The Copernicus Conference called by Dianna ends in
failure. The decisive battle begins, with each side
staking its beliefs and ideal world on the outcome.
Durandal and Scirocco personally take the field to
settle the conflict. As both are defeated, the
battle begins to subside, but the Frost brothers'
Satellite Launcher pierces Messiah, where Durandal
has taken refuge. Amid the confusion, Dewey's
trump card, Oratorio No. 8, is fired.

Dewey aims to drop Messiah and destroy the
Command Cluster, the Coralians' core. The Frost
brothers, Ghingnham, and the Shadow Angels under
Sirius attack the group as they try to stop him.
In the fighting, Sirius learns Toma has used him
and boards the Aquarion once more. The group
defeats Dewey, but that triggers the system
planted in Eureka and Anemone. The collapse of the
Shadow Angels' Tree of Life causes spacetime to
collapse as well; Eureka brings it under control
by becoming the acting Command Cluster herself.

The Copernicus Conference called by Dianna ends in
failure. The decisive battle begins, with each side
staking its beliefs and ideal world on the outcome.
Durandal and Scirocco personally take the field to
settle the conflict, while the group fights former
comrades including Shinn. As both leaders are
defeated, the battle begins to subside, but the
Frost brothers' Satellite Launcher pierces Messiah,
where Durandal has taken refuge. Amid the
confusion, Dewey's trump card, Oratorio No. 8, is
fired.

Dewey aims to drop Messiah and destroy the
Command Cluster, the Coralians' core. The Frost
brothers, Ghingnham, and the Shadow Angels under
Sirius attack the group as they try to stop him.
In the fighting, Sirius learns Toma has used him
and boards the Aquarion once more. The group
defeats Dewey, but that triggers the system
planted in Eureka and Anemone. The collapse of the
Shadow Angels' Tree of Life causes spacetime to
collapse as well; Eureka brings it under control
by becoming the acting Command Cluster herself.

Renton meets his sister Diane and the others,
merged with the Scub Coral between dimensions.
Transported to Paradigm City, the group is met by
Alex and Guin, who have obtained dimensional power
and the legacy of the Black History. After
defeating their army, the group faces Asakim and
the Black Charisma. Forced to choose the future,
Roger rejects the Taikyoku's will and seeks to
negotiate with the Angel to save the world. Roger
reaches the Angel, and the group returns to the
outside world.

Judging all hostile forces eliminated, Edel Bernal
finally proclaimed herself ruler of the world. In
response, the group set out to occupy UN Station
to repair spacetime and reveal the truth to the
world. They fought the large Chimera force
defending the station head-on, defeating Lowen,
Schlan, and Ziene. Quattro, representing the group,
broadcast the truth of the multi-worlds born from
Break the World. He announced that, in twenty-four
hours, spacetime would be repaired according to all
humanity's will, determining the world's future.

Edel seeks to retake UN Station and control
everyone. The group defeats her in Chimera's trump
card, Lemures, and climbs the orbital elevator to
free Eureka. The mastermind, The Edel Bernal, the
Black Charisma himself, attacks to plunge the world
into chaos for his selfish desires. As they fight
him, Apollo, Sirius, and Toma form the true Genesis
union to hold the collapsing dimensions together.
With the will of people worldwide, the group repairs
spacetime.

finally proclaimed herself ruler of the world. In
response, the group set out to occupy UN Station
to repair spacetime and reveal the truth to the
world. They fought the large Chimera force

With the will of people worldwide, the group repairs

Edel seeks to retake UN Station and control
everyone. The group defeats Edel's Lemures,
Chimera's trump card, and climbs the orbital
elevator, but the time limit has been reached. The
incomplete spacetime repair gives birth to a dark
future trapped in an endless cycle of war.

Chimera aims to reform the New Earth Federation
military from within. The group responds, each in
their own way, to the request for cooperation from
Chimera's envoy, Captain Lowen. They split into two
groups, taking new courses toward the Pacific and
the continent of Gallia.

After meeting Brigadier General Edel, the group
leaves Chimera's base. The Minerva and Argama head
to Gibraltar Base to meet Durandal, while the King
Beal watches for movements by the alien alliance
